host_work: Input validation, scheduling within NPU-produced rectangles, and address generation/gather/scatter. Triangle bounds, coverage, interpolation, shading and merging execute on the selected device. Existing kernel clear/copy and presentation paths remain separate.
performance_scope: One warm repeat per captured operation on each build, run serially on Delta; no frame delivery or Tahoma performance claim.
preserved_failures: v109 first build failed due mixed C++ initializer-list element types.

Subsequent NPU diagnostics exposed large-coordinate errors in reduction/clamp and fixed-point bias paths. Explicit integer comparisons/bit selection plus low-byte ceil adjustment pass the same exact oracle on CPU and NPU.
